text: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰12日在钓鱼台国宾馆会见美中关系全国委员会董事会执行副主席格林伯格一行时表示，习近平主席不久前对美国进行国事访问，两国元首同意构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系”。中美双方应共同落实好两国元首重要共识，为中美经贸合作与世界经济注入更多确定性和稳定性。希望美中关系全国委员会为推动中美经济合作继续发挥积极作用。美方表示，美中关系稳定发展十分重要，愿继续发挥纽带作用，推动双方加强经济交流合作。（新华社）
text_en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met on the 12th at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse with a delegation led by Greenberg, Executive Vice Chairman of the Board of the National Committee on United States-China Relations. He said that President Xi Jinping recently paid a state visit to the United States, and the two heads of state agreed to build a "constructive China-US strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity." China and the United States should jointly implement the important consensus of the two heads of state and inject more certainty and stability into China-US economic and trade cooperation and the world economy. He expressed the hope that the National Committee on United States-China Relations will continue to play a positive role in promoting China-US economic cooperation. The US side said that the stable development of US-China relations is very important and that it is willing to continue to serve as a bridge and promote stronger economic exchanges and cooperation between the two sides. (Xinhua News Agency)
